package scheduled_agent_task

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/ai-agent-os/ai-agent-os/dto"
	"github.com/ai-agent-os/ai-agent-os/sdk/agent-app/app"
	"github.com/ai-agent-os/ai-agent-os/sdk/agent-app/response"
)

type UpdateReq struct {
	TaskID              int64  `json:"task_id" widget:"name:任务 ID;type:number;min:1" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Name                string `json:"name" widget:"name:任务名称;type:input"`
	FullCodePath        string `json:"full_code_path" widget:"name:工作台目录完整路径;type:input;placeholder:/user/app/path"`
	Goal                string `json:"goal" widget:"name:执行目标;type:text_area;rows:6"`
	ModeCode            string `json:"mode_code" widget:"name:工作台模式;type:input;placeholder:不填不修改"`
	UpdateFiles         bool   `json:"update_files" widget:"name:更新文件引用;type:switch;render_default:false"`
	Files               string `json:"files" widget:"name:文件引用;type:files;max_count:100"`
	UpdateLLMConfigID   bool   `json:"update_llm_config_id" widget:"name:更新 LLM 配置 ID;type:switch;render_default:false"`
	LLMConfigID         int64  `json:"llm_config_id" widget:"name:LLM 配置 ID;type:number;min:0"`
	ContextPolicy       string `json:"context_policy" widget:"name:上下文策略 JSON;type:text_area;placeholder:不填不修改"`
	ToolPolicy          string `json:"tool_policy" widget:"name:工具策略 JSON;type:text_area;placeholder:不填不修改"`
	ApprovalPolicy      string `json:"approval_policy" widget:"name:审批策略 JSON;type:text_area;placeholder:不填不修改"`
	BudgetPolicy        string `json:"budget_policy" widget:"name:预算策略 JSON;type:text_area;placeholder:不填不修改"`
	ScheduleType        string `json:"schedule_type" widget:"name:调度类型;type:select;options:atime,cron,every"`
	RunAt               string `json:"run_at" widget:"name:执行时间;type:datetime;format:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss"`
	CronExpr            string `json:"cron_expr" widget:"name:Cron 表达式;type:input;placeholder:不填不修改"`
	UpdateInterval      bool   `json:"update_interval" widget:"name:更新间隔秒数;type:switch;render_default:false"`
	IntervalSeconds     int64  `json:"interval_seconds" widget:"name:间隔秒数;type:number;min:0"`
	UpdateMaxRuns       bool   `json:"update_max_runs" widget:"name:更新最多执行次数;type:switch;render_default:false"`
	MaxRuns             int    `json:"max_runs" widget:"name:最多执行次数;type:number;min:0"`
	Timezone            string `json:"timezone" widget:"name:时区;type:input;placeholder:不填不修改"`
	RequestUser         string `json:"request_user" widget:"name:执行用户;type:user"`
	RequestUserDept     string `json:"request_user_dept" widget:"name:执行用户部门;type:department"`
	UpdateNotifyTargets bool   `json:"update_notify_targets" widget:"name:更新通知对象;type:switch;render_default:false"`
	NotifyUsers         string `json:"notify_users" widget:"name:通知用户;type:users"`
	NotifyDepartments   string `json:"notify_departments" widget:"name:通知部门;type:departments"`
	NotifyOn            string `json:"notify_on" widget:"name:通知条件;type:select;options:none,all,success,failed"`
}

type UpdateResp struct {
	TaskID       int64  `json:"task_id" widget:"name:任务 ID;type:number"`
	Name         string `json:"name" widget:"name:任务名称;type:input"`
	Status       string `json:"status" widget:"name:状态;type:input"`
	NextRunAt    string `json:"next_run_at" widget:"name:下次执行时间;type:input"`
	ScheduleType string `json:"schedule_type" widget:"name:调度类型;type:input"`
	FullCodePath string `json:"full_code_path" widget:"name:工作台目录完整路径;type:input"`
	Summary      string `json:"summary" widget:"name:更新结果;type:text_area"`
	TaskJSON     string `json:"task_json" widget:"name:任务 JSON;type:text_area"`
}

func Update(ctx *app.Context, resp response.Response) error {
	var req UpdateReq
	if err := ctx.ShouldBindValidate(&req); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	contextPolicy, err := optionalJSONObject("context_policy", req.ContextPolicy)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	toolPolicy, err := optionalJSONObject("tool_policy", req.ToolPolicy)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	approvalPolicy, err := optionalJSONObject("approval_policy", req.ApprovalPolicy)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	budgetPolicy, err := optionalJSONObject("budget_policy", req.BudgetPolicy)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	apiReq := &dto.UpdateScheduledAgentTaskReq{
		Name:            strings.TrimSpace(req.Name),
		FullCodePath:    strings.TrimSpace(req.FullCodePath),
		Goal:            strings.TrimSpace(req.Goal),
		ModeCode:        strings.TrimSpace(req.ModeCode),
		Files:           optionalStringPtr(req.UpdateFiles, req.Files),
		LLMConfigID:     optionalInt64(req.UpdateLLMConfigID, req.LLMConfigID),
		ContextPolicy:   contextPolicy,
		ToolPolicy:      toolPolicy,
		ApprovalPolicy:  approvalPolicy,
		BudgetPolicy:    budgetPolicy,
		ScheduleType:    strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.ScheduleType)),
		RunAt:           strings.TrimSpace(req.RunAt),
		CronExpr:        strings.TrimSpace(req.CronExpr),
		IntervalSeconds: optionalInt64(req.UpdateInterval, req.IntervalSeconds),
		MaxRuns:         optionalInt(req.UpdateMaxRuns, req.MaxRuns),
		Timezone:        strings.TrimSpace(req.Timezone),
		RequestUser:     strings.TrimSpace(req.RequestUser),
		RequestUserDept: strings.TrimSpace(req.RequestUserDept),
		NotifyOn:        strings.TrimSpace(req.NotifyOn),
	}
	if req.UpdateNotifyTargets || strings.TrimSpace(req.NotifyOn) != "" {
		apiReq.NotifyUsers = splitCSV(req.NotifyUsers)
		apiReq.NotifyDepartments = splitCSV(req.NotifyDepartments)
	}

	var item dto.ScheduledAgentTaskItem
	path := fmt.Sprintf("/agent/api/v1/scheduled_agent_tasks/%d", req.TaskID)
	if err := ctx.APICall(http.MethodPut, path, apiReq, &item); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("[系统错误]-[ScheduledAgentTaskUpdate] 更新智能体定时任务失败, req: %+v, err: %w", req, err)
	}

	taskJSON, err := marshalPretty(item)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("[系统错误]-[ScheduledAgentTaskUpdate] 序列化任务结果失败: %w", err)
	}
	return resp.Form(&UpdateResp{
		TaskID:       item.ID,
		Name:         item.Name,
		Status:       item.Status,
		NextRunAt:    formatTimePtr(item.NextRunAt),
		ScheduleType: item.ScheduleType,
		FullCodePath: item.FullCodePath,
		Summary:      formatTaskSummary("智能体定时任务已更新", &item),
		TaskJSON:     taskJSON,
	}).Build()
}

var UpdateTemplate = &app.FormTemplate{
	BaseConfig: app.BaseConfig{
		Name:     "更新智能体定时任务",
		Desc:     "更新智能体定时任务的目标、调度、文件引用、模型配置和通知对象。仅非空字段会更新，数值和文件引用需打开对应开关。",
		Tags:     []string{"智能体定时任务", "更新", "平台接口", "副作用"},
		Request:  &UpdateReq{},
		Response: &UpdateResp{},
	},
}

func init() {
	packageContext.POST("update.form", Update, UpdateTemplate)
}
